A multi-site laboratory or sensor panel, not neuroimaging.

```{r}
library(referent)
set.seed(4)
ref <- norm_simulate(300)
spec <- norm_spec(
  family = norm_gaussian(),
  location = ~ s(age, k = 6) + sex + s(site, bs = "re"),
  scale = ~ 1
)
fit <- norm_fit(spec, data = ref, outcomes = starts_with("marker_"))
print(fit)
scores <- predict(fit, newdata = ref[1:3, ], uncertainty = "conditional")
scores[, c(".row", ".outcome", "observed", "centile", "z")]
```
